BAD_INPUT: That input could not be used. Check it and try again.
PROMPT_BLOCKED: Please change your prompt and try a safe, workshop-friendly idea.
UNAUTHORIZED: That mentor PIN was not accepted.
CLIENT_BLOCKED: This device has been paused by a mentor.
JOB_NOT_FOUND: That image job could not be found. Please start again.
RATE_LIMITED: Please wait a moment before trying again.
QUEUE_FULL: The workshop image queue is full. Please try again shortly.
MODEL_NOT_READY: The image model is still starting. Please try again in a moment.
QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The explanation service has reached today's workshop limit.
PAUSED_BY_MENTOR: The mentor has paused new image requests.
LEARN_DISABLED: Explanations are currently turned off by the mentor.
LEARN_UNAVAILABLE: The explanation service is temporarily unavailable.
SAFETY_BLOCKED: The image was stopped by the safety check. Try a different sketch or prompt.
GPU_OUT_OF_MEMORY: The laptop ran out of graphics memory. Try Fast quality or ask your mentor for help.
GENERATION_TIMEOUT: The image took too long. Try Fast quality and submit again.
GENERATION_FAILED: The image could not be created. Please try again.
TIMEOUT: The image took too long to create. Please try again.
NETWORK_ERROR: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
